data.summary:
Senior Program Manager with 12+ years of experience delivering enterprise-wide Business Change and Transformation programes across Global Banking, Payments, Lending, and Financial Services. Extensive experience leading Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM), Client Onboarding, KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), AML, Financial Crime Compliance, and Regulatory Change initiatives.
Proven track record of driving large-scale strategic programes involving business, operations, compliance, risk, technology, and executive leadership. Experienced in program governance, business case development, investment prioritization, executive reporting, roadmap planning, RAID management, stakeholder engagement, and delivery of complex cross-functional transformation programes aligned with regulatory and business objectives.
Successfully led enterprise transformation initiatives spanning Client Lifecycle Management, Regulatory Remediation, Payments Modernization, Fraud Prevention, Digital Onboarding, Operational Excellence, and Governance frameworks across global financial institutions.
